subject: Staff clearance rechecks & training attestations
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cicero-fin.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: security@cicero-fin.com
Date: 2026-08-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: staff clearance rechecks & training attestations

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the continued partnership. As part of our annual vendor re-assessment (SOC 2 refresh), our security team needs updated evidence around staff background rechecks and training attestations for Redwood personnel who handle customer data for Cicero Financial. Specifically we need:

- An itemized roster of active staff with role, hire date, most recent background check date, and verifier (third-party provider).
- Copies or redacted summaries of the background recheck results for the sample cohort (we usually accept a 10-person sample).
- LMS completion logs for security awareness and data handling training (date completed + version of training).
- The onboarding/offboarding deprovisioning runbook or a redacted excerpt that shows account deactivation timelines and artifact retention steps.
- A signed sample of the employee background consent form (redacted PII ok).
- Mapping of the above controls to SIG/CAIQ questions if available (optional, but helpful).

Preferably we receive a consolidated package via a secure share (Google Drive link or the DocuSign envelope for consent forms). Can you target next Wednesday 2026-08-11 for delivery? If any of the materials need extra approvals, let us know and we can be flexible.

Attachments we anticipate: signed-consent-sample.pdf (redacted), training-logs.csv, deprovisioning-runbook.pdf

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Lead Vendor Security Analyst
Cicero Financial
security@cicero-fin.com

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the package and will route PII-sensitive artifacts through our secure share and DocuSign for consent forms. A few quick notes and a request so we scope the package correctly:

- Background checks: Redwood uses TrustCheck (third-party) for pre-hire and annual rechecks for employees in production-facing roles. For the sample we can provide redacted summaries (no SSNs), and a verifier report from TrustCheck.
- Training: our LMS is LearnSafe; we keep completion records with timestamp and training module version. We can export a CSV with employee email, module, completion date, and score.
- Deprovisioning: I'll include the runbook excerpt that shows timed account deactivation flows and escalation points, redacted for internal contact info.

Action items for Redwood: Monica, can you prepare the 10-person sample roster and redacted check summaries? Aditya, can you pull the LearnSafe export for the last 12 months for the rostered users and pre-stage the runbook excerpt for redaction?

Liam — we'll aim to deliver the secure bundle by 2026-08-11. If you want the consent forms via DocuSign, confirm and we'll send an envelope link. Otherwise we'll upload redacted PDFs to the secure Drive.

Thanks,
Sooyn Lee

Sooyn — received the package. Thanks for the quick turnaround and for the redactions; the Drive link and DocuSign envelope both work. A couple of quick clarifications before we close our control map:

1) For the TrustCheck verifier summary, can you confirm the last recheck types (criminal, employment verification) performed for the sample? A one-line mapping per sample entry is enough.
2) On the deprovisioning runbook excerpt: can you confirm whether privileged account deactivation is automated or manual (and the typical SLA in hours)?

If possible, send those two clarifications as a short follow-up and we'll finalize the SIG mapping on our side. If it's easier, we're happy to take the 30-minute walkthrough you suggested; I can schedule for 2026-08-10 or 2026-08-11.

Thanks — Liam
